name: Noah Sailing
source:
Noah Sailing is a fairly famous adventurer from the Keith Guild. She forms a team with [url=/c96892]Lark Pikespeak[/url], and they are well known as an impeccable duo. One of her greatest feats with Lark, was the defeat of a powerful Monster known as Kas A before.

A charming and beautiful young lady, Noah is polite and amiable. Mostly proficient with supportive and healing magic, she provided an outstanding assistance to her partners in battle. 

[From [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/Noa]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
